overviewHtml:
Automating account configuration needs the right groups and policies in place first. This sample sets up both for Monaco to manage Grail buckets and automations.

What you get

  • Account configuration deployed with Monaco
  • Policies, boundaries and groups for Monaco admin access
  • User assignments for Config-as-Code OAuth clients
  • A script to fill in environment ID and user email
setupHtml:
Pre-requisites

  • Monaco CLI version 2.11.0+
  • An OAuth token granting Dynatrace Account access
  • The following environment variables defined
  • ACCOUNT_UUID ... the UUID of your account
  • ACCOUNT_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID ... your oAuth client's ID
  • ACCOUNT_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET ... your oAuth client's secret

You will also need to fill the sample configuration with actual values for your environment ID and the user you will tie Config-as-Code admin oAuth clients to.

You can do this either by manually replacing the following values:

  • %YOUR_ENVIRONMENT_ID% in groups.yaml
  • %YOUR_USER_EMAIL% in users.yaml and delete.yaml

Or by setting your desired values as environment variables YOUR_ENVIRONMENT_ID and YOUR_USER_EMAIL and running the configure.sh shell script. (Requires sed command line tool to be installed)

Then you can deploy your configurations using monaco

monaco account deploy -m manifest-account.yaml
getStartedHtml:
You need Monaco and an OAuth client with account access.

  1. Set the account environment variables
  2. Fill in your environment ID and user email
  3. Deploy the account manifest with Monaco

Full setup instructions are in the README.
